what_happened: On an open highway with the road ahead clear (the lead was 43–59 m away), the ego braked hard for no reason, from 15.7 to 6.6 m/s, and drifted slightly left of the recorded path. At 8.1 s, actor 28 came up from behind on the ego's right rear and overlapped it. The scenario flags this as an at-fault front collision, but it is really the result of a following actor that does not react hitting a car that braked for nothing.
